description: Settings to reduce PR frequency: runs and PR creation are batched into Monday mornings each week, and the concurrent/hourly PR counts are capped.

The basic versioning policy is 'minor pinned, patch floating'. Images with a minor tag (e.g. mysql:8.4) and ~ ranges in package.json pick up patches automatically, so no PR is opened for them. Images without a minor tag (Kafka, Specmatic, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) are fully pinned, so patch updates arrive as PRs.
For *_VERSION in .env.example, the version is read via the `# renovate: depName=...` annotation on the preceding line; for compose `image: xxx:${VAR:-default}`, the image name itself is used.

Updates are grouped to reduce the number of PRs. Patch updates automerge once CI passes; minor updates need human review. 0.x versions can change behavior even in patches, so they are never automerged, even for patch. Playwright is a single group because the npm package and the Docker image (which bundles the browsers) must always have matching versions.
